text:
alyssa-peopleops: Quick Q 1: Diego is moving from IC to PM (lateral-to-manager track) and Tom wants the promotion effective 2026-04-01 but keep Diego's original hire date for equity cliff/vesting purposes. Is that allowed? Need comp & payroll implications.

tom-hiring-manager: yea we agreed to promote to PM but team asked we don't reset the hire date for equity so his 4-year cliff stays anchored to 2022-07-15. I thought that was standard but want to confirm. Also want bonus eligibility to start on the promo date.

diego: hi all 1: correct, i want my vesting schedule unchanged. will the title change affect 1) cliff, 2) start-of-bonus-year, 3) eligibility for manager bonus plan?

sam-comp: short answer: title/level change usually does not change original grant dates. Grants are governed by grant agreements. If you are moving to a manager band we typically issue a new grant (augmentation) rather than re-dating the original. Need to review current grant docs; comp can propose an augmentation grant to reflect the promotion without altering cliff.

jess-payroll: payroll-wise nothing to change for base pay effective date as long as comp paperwork shows effective date. For equity we coordinate with StockOps. For manager bonus plan enrollment we need comp sign-off and an updated eligible target. Also watch out for 409A or local withholding triggers if grant is issued.

alyssa-peopleops: ok next: manager wants salary bump to $155k effective 2026-04-01 and a promotion letter that keeps hire date. What's our checklist?

sam-comp: checklist: 1) confirm grant agreement language (StockOps cc), 2) create augmentation grant if needed (amount/%), 3) comp director approval for increase, 4) updated offer/promo letter with explicit lines: effective date for comp change, statement that prior equity grant dates remain unchanged, and bonus plan enrollment rules.

hr-ops-bot: Note: internal transfers across bands that keep hire date require a Comp Director case note and StockOps acknowledgement. See playbook link: https://intranet.redwood/comp/playbook#internal-transfers

jess-payroll: manager also asked about retroactive pay for April payroll if paperwork completes after cutoff. Our next run is 2026-04-10 18:00 UTC, cutoff 2026-04-09 23:59 UTC. Add payroll ticket referencing employee id and attach signed promo letter.

tom-hiring-manager: draft promo letter posted here for review. Does this language work?

```
Subject: Promotion: Diego (EMPID 67890) to Product Manager

Effective date: 2026-04-01
New title: Product Manager
New base salary: $155,000 annual
Equity: Existing grant(s) dated 2022-07-15 remain unchanged; any promotional equity will be issued as an augmentation with grant date separate from original grant.
Bonus: Enrolled in Manager Bonus Plan effective 2026-04-01. No change to previous bonus payouts.

Manager signature: Tom [last]
Date: 2026-03-28
```

sam-comp: language looks good. Add a line about reporting manager and full-time status. Also cc StockOps and Comp Director when sending.

lattice-bot: Lattice snapshot requested: please attach current approval history and existing grant docs to the payroll ticket.

jess-payroll: please open ticket PAY-2026-4901 with subject "Promo & equity note - Diego 67890 - effective 2026-04-01" and attach promo letter + Lattice snapshot + grant docs. Tag @sam-comp and @stockops. We'll confirm payroll inclusion after comp director OK.

sam-comp: Comp Director approved augmentation approach at 15:40 UTC. We'll draft grant terms for StockOps review.

tom-hiring-manager: opened PAY-2026-4901 and attached files. CC'd comp & stockops.

diego: thanks team 1: curious if manager bonus is prorated for April?

sam-comp: yes manager bonus pro-rated from promotion effective date; comp & payroll will confirm precise proration. We'll include target % in the ticket.

jess-payroll: we'll run a proration calc once documents are attached. Example code (rough):

```
monthly_new = 155000 / 12
monthly_old = previous_salary / 12
proration = monthly_new * (days_in_month_post_effective / days_in_month)
```

We'll post final numbers in PAY-2026-4901.

alyssa-peopleops: final action items: Tom send signed promo letter email CC comp + stockops, open payroll ticket (done), comp will create augmentation grant terms, StockOps to confirm grant will keep original grant date unchanged, payroll to confirm proration in ticket. I'll update playbook note about internal transfer templates. Leaving thread open until PAY-2026-4901 closed. :white_check_mark:"
